title: A Peaceful Settlement
description: Elder Mara, the leader of the Dantooine settlement, needs help with various tasks to keep the settlement running smoothly. The settlement is growing, and that brings challenges: establishing trade routes, mediating disputes, building infrastructure. They're not asking for handouts—they're asking for partnership. Can you help them?
shortDescription: Help the settlement with various tasks and challenges

objectives.description: Speak with Elder Mara about settlement needs
Complete settlement tasks (trade negotiations, dispute mediation, infrastructure help)
